_meta.idRule: original collectible id (lowest dbf, not CORE_/VAN_/HERO_ reprints); boss-only names -> the only non-collectible id
_meta.deckSizeNote: Boss deck size grows with the level (wiki The_Dalaran_Heist: 'increase their deck size in tandem with the boss' decks increasing in size'); the random-deck pages give 10;15 (Marei Loom, L1-2), 15;20 (Hesutu, L2-3), 20;25 (Dagg, L3-5), 25 (Deryl/Zibb, L4-5); Banker Biggs/Kazamon pages say level-5 / level-4-5 decks miss 5 random cards.

missing.name: Commander Bolan
missing.why: Wiki: 'Commander Bolan has no deck and will instead summon minions from turn to turn like Tad.' (https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Commander_Bolan). A Blizzard forum post (https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/hearthstone/t/commander-bolans-deck/8293) reports Discovering these cards from his deck (no counts; a reply notes they are Tirion's Frozen Throne prologue cards): Eager Rogue (ICCA01_007, dbf 45359), Terrible Tank (ICCA01_008, dbf 45360), Needy Hunter (ICCA01_009, dbf 45361), A. F. Kay (ICCA01_010, dbf 45362), Warlock on Fire (ICCA01_011, dbf 45363). Check the client's HERO_DECK_ID for him before inventing a deck.
